reason: Stock Settings documents a Limit Percent for over-delivery/receipt and a 'Role Allowed to Over Deliver/Receive' exception. The adapter supplies trusted.derivedMaximumQty (the computed allowance ceiling) and trusted.authorizedRole (whether the caller holds the over-deliver/receive role). The policy permits the request when the authorized role is present, or when the requested qty is within the derived maximum. No unrelated validation is added.
